prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `lower_bound` and `upper_bound` in src/lib.rs on a sorted slice. `lower_bound` returns the first index whose value is greater than or equal to the target; `upper_bound` returns the first index whose value is strictly greater. Both return `values.len()` when no such index exists. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
